authority.owner_decision: PENDING — preregistered before first decisive scoring run
authority.change_policy: immutable_after_first_decisive_inference; changes require a new version and a new pre-run hash

purpose: Decide whether the spaCy dependency-path relation extractor produces asserted-only graph edges at sufficient precision and recall to own the deterministic relation lane. Evaluated against a hand-labeled asserted-only gold fixture derived from semantic_extraction_gold_v1.json and extended to the thin-evidence floor. GLiREL fine-tuned classifier is the comparison baseline on identical fixture and identical entity inputs.

parent_gold.note: Original full gold (9 samples). Asserted subset derived per derivation_rule in fixture. Claim path scored against this full gold; edge path scored against the asserted subset.

extractor_config.note: Ontology provides allowed_pairs only. Emittable predicates = ghost_b_schemas.py Predicate Literal (30 values).

spacy_dep_path.parser_ab_note: A/B vs en_core_web_md run 2026-07-27: identical output on 9-sample fixture. sm retained for speed.
spacy_dep_path.resolver: 4-tier composite: T1(sig+lemma+types), T2(sig+lemma), T3(flat synonym), T4(DROP)
spacy_dep_path.emittable_predicates: ghost_b_schemas.py Predicate Literal (30 values, exact set match with _VALID_PREDICATES)

glirel_baseline.device: mps (HOST sidecar :8084, torch not in container)
glirel_baseline.entity_inputs: identical gold entity spans from fixture (not GLiNER predictions)
glirel_baseline.note: GLiREL receives the SAME gold entities as the dep-path extractor for fair A/B. Runs on HOST MPS via ghost_b_extract_svc.

decision_base.unit: one gold asserted relation matched by (subject_surface, predicate, object_surface) triple, normalized lowercase
decision_base.scoring: exact string match on normalized (subject, predicate, object) after lowercasing and stripping
decision_base.prediction_filter: only ExtractedTriple with is_graph_edge=True (polarity=POSITIVE, modality=ASSERTED, assertion_mode=direct)

dual_denominator.edge_path: is_graph_edge predictions scored against asserted-only subset (this fixture)
dual_denominator.claim_path: all predictions (including suppressed) scored against full parent gold

decision_base.thin_evidence_rationale: The fixture is a small adversarial canary extended to floor. A legitimate reading requires spanning multiple samples and predicate families. Falling below any minimum yields insufficient_evidence, never pass.

verdict_precedence: If any thin-evidence minimum is missed: insufficient_evidence.
Else if every pass gate criterion is true: extractor_passes and dep-path lane may proceed.
Else: extractor_below_gate and remediation required before next scoring run.
anti_gaming: No sample-ID, text, or gold-answer branching in extraction or scoring.
No post-run threshold, label, denominator, or gate edits.
The same extractor config (predicate_synonyms.yaml, ontology.yaml) is used for all samples.
Gold fixture is sha256-pinned before scoring. Any edit requires a new version.
No ontology edits pending owner ratification are applied before gate scoring.
GLiREL baseline uses identical entity inputs (gold spans), not its own NER predictions.
Determinism check: two full runs must produce byte-identical JSON output.
